episodes.title: This Cult Story is AWFUL | Chloe Driver Polygamist Cult True Crime
episodes.description:
This is one of the most AWFUL true crime stories I’ve covered.

Chloe Alexis Driver was just 17 when she met 38-year-old Brian Joyce (also known as Benyamin Ben Michael). What started as a relationship quickly turned into a controlling polygamist cult lifestyle — multiple “wives,” extreme religious beliefs, isolation, rejection of modern medicine, and living nomadically in a van.

In this video I break down the full story: how Chloe was manipulated, the other women involved, the toxic beliefs of Brian and his friend Jason, the birth of her daughter Hannah, and the tragic events of December 2020 that led to Chloe being found guilty but mentally ill and sentenced to life in prison.

This case is heavy. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.
